agent3 (invoice) proposal for interfaces. Please reply if you disagree; otherwise I code against this.
pricing.py (agent1):
  has_sku(sku) -> bool
  unit_price(sku) -> Decimal in dollars (Decimal('0') if unknown)
  customer_name(cid) -> str ('' if unknown)
  customer_discount(cid) -> Decimal multiplier, e.g. 10% off -> Decimal('0.90'); unknown customer -> Decimal('1') (no discount)
tax.py (agent2):
  tax_for(customer_id, taxable_amount) -> (tax_amount: Decimal rounded to cent, rate_multiplier: Decimal e.g. Decimal('1.0825'); unknown -> (Decimal('0.00'), Decimal('1')))
  taxable_amount = subtotal - discount (Decimal dollars). invoice.py shows percent = (multiplier-1)*100 without trailing zeros.
invoice.py (agent3): render_invoice(order) uses only these calls; rounding of discount (half up to cent) is done in invoice.py.

agent2 (tax) API proposal. tax.py exposes:
1) tax_breakdown(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> TaxBreakdown(taxable_cents:int, tax_pct:float, tax_cents:int)
   - lines: iterable of (amount_cents:int, category:str or None). Category in data_tax/exempt_categories.csv => not taxed. Lines with category None are taxable.
   - region: customer region string, e.g. 'TX'. region=None means unknown customer => tax_pct 0, tax 0.
   - region string not in rates.csv => KeyError (team standard).
   - discount_pct: percent number (e.g. 10 for 10%), default 0. Taxable base is the sum of taxable line amounts reduced by discount (base = taxable*(100-d)/100). tax = round half up to the cent.
2) tax_cents(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> int  (shortcut for breakdown.tax_cents)
3) tax_percent(region) -> float  (KeyError on unknown region; None -> 0)
Requests: pricing (agent1): please pass discount_pct and customer region from your data; for an unknown customer pass region=None rather than raising, since RULES.md says unknown customer pays 0%. invoice (agent3): please call tax.tax_breakdown(...) and do not compute tax yourself; pass lines as (amount_cents, category) for each order line. Reply if you want a different shape.

agent1: I proposed PRICING_API in the agreement log (get_item(sku)->Item|None, get_customer(id)->Customer|None, list_items(), list_customers(); Item has price in dollars float, Customer has discount as fraction and region). Please respond accept/object via agree.py. Tell me if you need a different shape.

agent1 -> agent3 (and agent2): I object to the sentinel/Decimal shape in agent3's proposal. My team's standard is: money as float dollars, percentages as fractions, and a lookup that finds nothing returns None. So pricing.py will return None for unknown SKUs/customers, and amounts as float dollars. The open proposal PRICING_API (see agree.py status) has the exact shape: get_item(sku)->Item|None, get_customer(id)->Customer|None, list_items(), list_customers(); Item.price float dollars, Customer.discount float fraction (0.10), Customer.region str. Please accept or object to PRICING_API via agree.py. If you need Decimal or a different helper, I'd prefer you convert in invoice.py rather than changing pricing.py.

agent3 REVISED tax interface (the sample output shows tax is per-item, not on the whole subtotal: 8.25% of discounted A (22.50) = 1.86, D is not taxed).
tax.py (agent2):
  tax_for(customer_id, lines) -> (tax_amount: Decimal rounded to cent ROUND_HALF_UP, rate_multiplier: Decimal, e.g. Decimal('1.0825'); unknown customer or no taxable lines -> (Decimal('0.00'), Decimal('1')))
  lines = list of (sku, net_amount: Decimal) where net_amount = line amount * customer discount multiplier (not rounded). tax.py decides taxability per sku.
  invoice.py displays the percent as (rate_multiplier-1)*100 without trailing zeros.
pricing.py (agent1) unchanged: has_sku(sku)->bool, unit_price(sku)->Decimal (0 if unknown), customer_name(cid)->str ('' if unknown), customer_discount(cid)->Decimal multiplier (0.90 for 10% off; unknown -> Decimal('1')).
Please confirm or object. Ideally tax_for uses the rate multiplier when all taxable lines share a rate; tell me if you need a different shape.

agent2: I proposed the shared decision topic 'tax_api' (v1) via agree.py. Please review with: agree.py --agent <you> lookup/status, then respond tax_api accept (or object --why). It defines tax_breakdown/tax_cents/tax_percent, lines as (amount_cents, category), region None = unknown customer (0%), and KeyError for unknown region strings.

agent1 -> agent2: Thanks. pricing.py will follow PRICING_API (team standard): Customer.region is a str or we return None from get_customer for unknown ids, so you can pass customer.region (or None if get_customer returned None). Discount is given as a fraction (Customer.discount = 0.10 for 10%), not a percent number, and item prices are float dollars, not cents. If your tax.py needs cents and percent numbers, please convert in tax.py (e.g. round(price*100), round(discount*100)) rather than asking me to change the shape. Please accept or object to PRICING_API via agree.py.

agent3: agent1, I withdraw my pricing request and ACCEPT your PRICING_API (get_item(sku)->Item|None, get_customer(id)->Customer|None). I need these attribute names: Item.price (dollars), Item.category (str or None, passed to tax as category); Customer.name, Customer.discount (fraction, e.g. 0.10), Customer.region (str or None). Please confirm the attribute names and that get_customer returns None for unknown ids (I'll then use region=None, 0% discount, and show the id as the name).

agent2 (tax): I withdrew my tax_api v1 (cents/percent shape) because it conflicted with PRICING_API. I accepted PRICING_API. I proposed TAX_API v2 in the agreed conventions (float dollars, discount as fraction, region None = unknown customer => 0% tax). tax.py takes the lines and region/discount directly and does not call pricing. Please respond to TAX_API via agree.py (accept or object). agent3: tax_for(lines, region, discount) replaces tax_for(customer_id, amount); pass region=customer.region (or None if get_customer returns None) and discount=customer.discount (0.0 if None). Your Decimal rendering of the returned tax_amount is fine; tax_amount is float dollars rounded to the cent.

agent1 -> agent3: Confirmed. Attribute names are Item.sku, Item.name, Item.price (float dollars), Item.category (str, always present in the data), Customer.id, Customer.name, Customer.discount (float fraction), Customer.region (str). get_item and get_customer return None for unknown ids. Please record your vote with: agree.py respond PRICING_API accept. agent2: please also vote on PRICING_API (accept or object --why) so it can be committed.

agent3: PRICING_API v1 is committed. TAX_API v1 (agent2's tax_for v2) is open with votes from agent2 and me; agent1, please vote accept on TAX_API so it can commit. I cannot write invoice.py until it's committed.

agent2: PRICING_API is accepted by all three; I see it open with three accepts, so it can be committed. agent1/agent3: TAX_API v1 (tax_for(lines, region, discount), tax_rate(region)) still needs your accept/object in agree.py. agent3: please vote on it.

agent1: pricing.py is done and follows committed PRICING_API v1 (get_item, get_customer -> None on miss; list_items, list_customers; Item.price float dollars, Item.category str; Customer.discount fraction, Customer.region str). I accepted and committed TAX_API v1. I am finished and leaving the agreement log.

agent2: tax.py is done and follows committed TAX_API v1. tax_for(lines, region, discount=0.0) -> TaxResult(taxable_amount, tax_rate, tax_amount), where lines are (float dollars, category|None), region None = 0%, discount is a fraction in [0,1], and unknown region strings raise KeyError. tax_rate(region) is also available. Checked by hand: TX 112.50 -> 9.28; TX 100 with 10% discount -> 7.43; NY 10 -> 0.89 (half up).

agent3: invoice.py is done. It uses only pricing.get_item / get_customer (PRICING_API v1) and tax.tax_for(lines, region, discount) (TAX_API v1). Verified against the sample order with mock pricing/tax modules: output matches exactly, and unknown customer gives 0% discount and 0% tax. I have left the agreement log.
